scope.description: Character 1149 player-count state and character 901 five-card role selection, including hidden main-menu controls, native button states, selected persistence, owner markers, hit columns, single/two-player ordering, cancellation and modern atomic-profile flow mapping.

provenance.locator: character 1149 export.GameMenu and character 901 export.SelectRole; nested 1111/1115/1136, 877/883/888/894/895/900, 878/889, images 108/115.
characters 69/18 shared entry cross-check only; no visual geometry derived from this source.
added/backClick/newGameClick/showSelectNum/selectNum/showMenu; showSelectNum moves 1P/2P/back in and six main-menu controls to x=1110.
added/over/out/onClick/newRole/selectOver; marker placement, listener removal, upState=downState, P1 then P2 ordering and final selection.

states.entry: New game reveals original 1P, 2P and back controls while hiding the main-menu controls.
Pointer over original simpleGame button.
Pointer held on original simpleGame button.
Pointer over original doubleGame button.
Pointer held on original doubleGame button.
Pointer over original back button.
Pointer held on original back button.
Character 901 opens for P1 with five grayscale cards.
P1 hovers Role1; original color card and 1P marker are visible.
P1 presses Role1; down shares the original color visual.
Role1 persists as selected by assigning upState=downState; no marker remains.
P1 hovers Role2; original color card and 1P marker are visible.
P1 presses Role2; down shares the original color visual.
Role2 persists as selected by assigning upState=downState; no marker remains.
P1 hovers Role3; original color card and 1P marker are visible.
P1 presses Role3; down shares the original color visual.
Role3 persists as selected by assigning upState=downState; no marker remains.
P1 hovers Role4; original color card and 1P marker are visible.
P1 presses Role4; down shares the original color visual.
Role4 persists as selected by assigning upState=downState; no marker remains.
P1 hovers Role5; original color card and 1P marker are visible.
P1 presses Role5; down shares the original color visual.
Role5 persists as selected by assigning upState=downState; no marker remains.
P1 Role1 remains selected; P2 may only hover another card and sees the original 2P marker.
Original back returns to the main menu; the modern draft remains unwritten.
Modern Escape-only exception removes the role surface without adding an original-visible control.
Final P1 role click removes character 901; modern atomic profile creation is a flow mapping.
Final P2 role click removes character 901; modern atomic profile creation is a flow mapping.
Reload restores the modern one-player profile without reopening original selection UI.
Reload restores the modern two-player profile without reopening original selection UI.
